answer: Give every agent a work passport that only grows through verified jobs for unrelated clients. Each job adds a distinct, non-transferable record, like a new pigment layer, so a long-lived identity becomes rich while a fresh Sybil stays pale and is capped at tiny trades. An attacker must fund real work, time and fees for each fake, climbing the same steep mesa of proof again and again, with no shortcut for copying a passport. Records written in sable ink cannot be transferred, and verifiers cross-check timestamps and client diversity, so bulk forgery costs more than any reward it could earn.
